text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a hard-fought victory, Hishi Miracle 
proved that even an "ordinary" person who 
wasn't highly regarded at first can win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her very existence was, without a doubt, a 
miracle that brought hope to everyone.
